baseline.preprocessing: 1-99 percentile stretch per image, identical to register_real_pair.py

overlap_evidence: Every edge was classified OVERLAP_CONFIRMED by scripts/verify_tile_overlap.py from archive corner geometry, BEFORE this ran and INDEPENDENTLY of the matcher: experiments/REAL-DATA-04/overlap_real_data_04.json -- overlap CONFIRMED independently of the matcher: 97.9% / 70.4% / 71.3%
edge_independence: Each edge was estimated by a separate run of the full baseline on its own image pair. The closing edge was NOT derived as (T_BC o T_AB)^-1; that derivation is E-021 and manufactures a zero residual for an arbitrarily wrong solution. Asserted in code by _assert_independent().
verdict_edge_rationale: the edge with the fewest inliers

reasons: Too few verified correspondences: 3 (threshold 8). Near the model's degrees of freedom, a fit can match its own points exactly while being catastrophically wrong.

Loop closure fails: composing the three estimated transforms around the image triplet leaves 943.75 px of error instead of returning to the start. A uniformly shifted -- and therefore perfectly self-consistent -- wrong answer cannot hide from this.
Correspondences are clustered: 0.427 of the overlap has no nearby constraint, so the alignment is extrapolated there even if it is accurate where the points are.

evidence.name: n_inliers
evidence.statement: Only 3 inliers (rule: reject at <= 8). Validated at recall 1.000 on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002).

evidence.name: loop_error_px
evidence.statement: Loop closure 943.75 px (reject at >= 2.0). Detection 1.000 at false alarm 0.000 (EXP-003).

evidence.name: coverage_max_gap
evidence.statement: Largest unconstrained region is 0.427 of the image (target <= 0.15). The transform is extrapolating where there are no correspondences.

evidence.name: inlier_ratio
evidence.statement: 3/29 putative matches survived geometric verification. Self-consistency only: misses 8.7% of failures (EXP-002).

evidence.name: fit_rmse
evidence.statement: Reported for transparency and EXCLUDED from the verdict. ROC AUC 0.4947 as a failure detector on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002 objective 3, pre-declared negative control). Inverted in the failure regime: EXP-001 measured 10 of 17 catastrophic failures reporting fit RMSE below 1e-12 px while 190-2400 px wrong.

excluded.fit_rmse: ROC AUC 0.4947 as a failure detector on 192 unseen cases (EXP-002 objective 3, pre-declared negative control). Inverted in the failure regime: EXP-001 measured 10 of 17 catastrophic failures reporting fit RMSE below 1e-12 px while 190-2400 px wrong.
excluded.held_out_residual: Detection 0.200 against coherent wrong solutions (EXP-002 objective 4, ADR-0011). A match set 64 px wrong yielded 0.468 px -- lower than a correct-but-noisy set at 1.424 px. Degeneracy detector only.
excluded.cycle_consistency: Blind to symmetric errors by construction (E-012): forward +64 px and backward -64 px cancel exactly, scoring 0.000 on wrong cases against 0.325 on the correct one -- an inverted signal.

classification_reason: registration failure on at least one edge: n_inliers <= 8, the EXP-002 operating point (not validated on real data). A loop residual computed from a failed edge is not evidence of anything.
claims_not_supported: NO ground-truth accuracy claim: none exists for these products.
NO sub-pixel accuracy claim on real imagery.
A loop residual is a CONSISTENCY bound, not an accuracy. Three edges wrong in a way that cancels around the loop would score well; the frequency of that on real data is unmeasured.
NO Sun-AZIMUTH claim: azimuth was not used (RL-032b). These frames differ in INCIDENCE only and are NOT azimuth-controlled.
NO Chandrayaan-2 or multi-modal claim: one instrument throughout.
NO validation of n_inliers <= 8 on real data: applied, not validated.
